segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the renewal and the 15 additional seats you mentioned for the Austin team, so we can keep the April 1 go-live clean.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We have 62 users today, and we want to move to 77 total. The main thing is keeping the invoice to one annual bill. Finance does not want a second mid-year invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. I’ve got it structured as a 12-month renewal starting April 1, with the 77 seats included from day one. Annual total is $46,200, and payment terms stay net 30 like your current agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I expected. Is the admin training still included? We need two sessions in late March, preferably March 24 and March 26.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, two remote admin sessions are included, 90 minutes each. I’ll put March 24 and March 26 as the target dates on the order form, and our onboarding lead will confirm exact times after signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One other thing, legal asked about the auto-renew language. Can we keep the 60-day notice period instead of moving to 90?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that’s fine. Your current contract has 60 days, and we can carry that forward. No change there.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If you send the order form today, I can route it to procurement. They usually turn these in three or four business days.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I’ll send it this afternoon. It’ll show 77 seats, April 1 through March 31, annual billing at $46,200, net 30, and the two March training sessions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy billing@northlakeparts.com. Once procurement signs, we’ll send the PO number back.
